Both native lines: median of three cohort statistics; bands: observed min-max, not confidence intervals. VRAM: maximum across trials.
Three repeats per native worker; ordinary references have one trial each. Native Windows; vLLM/SGLang WSL.
Native B1 queues; native B4 uses fixed microbatches with private padding; references allow8 active requests. Dummy tokens excluded.
Native GDN/reference SSM recurrent state: FP32; attention KV: BF16. Native conv state: FP32; reference conv dtype unverified. Prefix/radix cache off.
All372 B4 prompt/output sequences match retained B1. Reference long-output variants remain; cross-engine equivalence unproven.
Adapter VRAM includes background allocations; not process/instantaneous peak. Maximum B4 sample gap: 42.129s.
Dashed guides use measured ordinary references only. Stronger tuned/MTP references and matched INT4/4B comparisons pending; overall2x unmet.
